service.description: Receive a customer return shipment's lines: for each return item the quantity that arrived, accepted and rejected (quarantined) alike, received as stock (AssetReceipt) on the item's shipment source, added to ReturnItem.receivedQuantity. It never changes returnQuantity and processes no response, so a second box, or units rejected at the dock, can still be received and credited against the authorization by settle#Return. An item reaches ReturnReceived (ReturnManResp for a manual response) when its received quantity equals the authorized quantity, the return when every item is handled, and the shipment ShipDelivered when every source is handled. Refuses more than was authorized (RECEIPT_EXCEEDS_RETURN), an item not on the shipment, a closed item, a shipment that is not a customer return, and an organization that does not settle returns separately (RETURN_SETTLEMENT_OFF: Mantle receives its returns when the shipment is delivered). Needs STOCK_RECEIVE in the receiving organization.

parameter.name: facilityId
parameter.description: Defaults to the shipment's destination facility.

parameter.name: itemList
parameter.description: Maps of returnId, returnItemSeqId, quantityAccepted, quantityRejected, rejectionReasonEnumId and, for the stock, statusId (default AstOnHold) and lotNumber.

parameter.name: receivedItems
parameter.description: Each item's returnId, returnItemSeqId, receivedQuantity, statusId and assetReceiptIds.

service.description: Move an asset, or part of it, to a location or a container of its own facility, through mantle.product.AssetServices.move#Asset: a part becomes its own asset there, the whole asset moves, and the reservations it carries move with it as Mantle moves them. A retry with the same operation key and request answers the first move (alreadyApplied); a different request under the key is OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT. Refuses without STOCK_MOVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); an asset outside the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), equipment (NOT_STOCK), nothing on hand (NO_STOCK), a quantity above on hand (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ON_HAND); another facility (OTHER_FACILITY: a transfer); a closed or missing location (LOCATION_CLOSED, LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE); the place it is already (SAME_LOCATION); a container holding another owner's stock (CONTAINER_OWNER); a quarantined asset to a location whose type would release it, or any status change with no status flow transition (HELD_STOCK, F8). Reservations carried onto stock that is not available are checked again, so the order is re-reserved on available stock (F38). Expired and near-expiry stock moves with a warning naming its date. workEffortId is the production run a staging move is for, kept in the answer.

parameter.name: operationKey
parameter.description: The client's operation id (a scan id or a form's operation id), at most 200 characters; scoped by user and operation type.

parameter.name: quantity
parameter.description: Empty moves the whole asset.

parameter.name: toContainerId
parameter.description: A container of the facility: the asset moves into it, at its location.

parameter.name: toFacilityId
parameter.description: Given only to refuse another facility.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode MOVED, assetId, toAssetId, productId, quantity, facilityId, fromLocationSeqId, toLocationSeqId, toContainerId, fromStatusId, statusId, reservationsChecked, warnings (code, expiryDate, message), reason, workEffortId, and the operation fields.

return.message: SAME_LOCATION: Asset ${assetId} is already at ${target.locationSeqId}

The batch is an operation too (StockRelocate, its request the assets and the destination): a retry answers the first batch's results, and a different request under the key is OPERATION_KEY_CONFLICT. Refuses the whole batch only without STOCK_MOVE (PERMISSION_DENIED) or with no asset.

Refuses as move#Stock: STOCK_MOVE, the user's facilities, another facility (OTHER_FACILITY), a closed location, the place it is (SAME_LOCATION). A retry with the same operation key answers the first.

service.description: Repair the reservations at a facility that WarehousePolicyServices.preview#FacilityReservations named, as previewed: refuses when they changed since (PREVIEW_CHANGED: preview again). A reservation on stock no longer available, for another facility's order or on a pool the order does not qualify for is checked again (check#AssetReservationValid: removed and re-reserved). For a not-available reservation of a product with available stock there, the product's not-available reservations at the facility, the previewed ones among them, are moved onto that stock (reserve#IncreasedAsset, which takes them in its own order), and each previewed one is reported as repaired or as still not available. Each in its own transaction: one that fails is named and the others go on. Requires STOCK_POLICY_MANAGE (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a facility of the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). A retry with the same operation key answers the first.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode REPAIRED, facilityId, productId, rows (per reservation: assetReservationId, orderId, orderItemSeqId, reasonCode, ok, message), repairedCount, failedCount.

return.message: PREVIEW_CHANGED: The reservations changed since the check; check them again

service.description: The one open receipt of a purchase order part: the part's ShpTpPurchase shipment in Input or Scheduled (resultCode EXISTING), or a new one through mantle.shipment.ShipmentServices.create#OrderPartShipment to the facility (CREATED), with the sources of lines in another unit converted to the product's stock unit. Warehouse's NewReceipt and Purchasing's expected receipt both call it, so a second request for the part opens the same receipt; a retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires STOCK_RECEIVE or PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a part outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an order that is not a purchase (NOT_PURCHASE) or not approved (ORDER_NOT_OPEN), a facility outside them (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) or none (FACILITY_REQUIRED), and a part with nothing left to receive (NOTHING_TO_RECEIVE).

service.description: Purchasing's revision of an order's quantities, called in the revision's transaction: each open purchase receipt source of the order (or of one part) is set to the line's new remaining quantity in stock units (the line less what its other receipts expect), never below what was received on it; each product's shipment item follows. The receipt is locked first, as the receive guard locks it, so a revision made while a receive holds the receipt waits for it and then applies to what was received (the framework's scripts have no skip-locked find to answer ReceiptInProgress at once: impl-warehouse F175). Requires STOCK_RECEIVE or PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT; refuses an order outside the user's organizations (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) or not a purchase (NOT_PURCHASE). A retry with the same operation key answers the first.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode ADJUSTED, orderId, sources (shipmentId, shipmentItemSourceId, orderItemSeqId, productId, fromQuantity, quantity, receivedQuantity).

return.message: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: Order ${orderId} is not available

A retry with the same operation key answers the first receipt. Requires STOCK_RECEIVE (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a receipt outside the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one that is not a purchase receipt (RECEIPT_TYPE) or no longer open (RECEIPT_CLOSED), a product not on it (PRODUCT_NOT_ON_RECEIPT), no quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), a rejection without a reason (REASON_REQUIRED), more than the policy's over-receipt tolerance allows, zero by default (OVER_RECEIPT), a serial count that does not match the accepted units (SERIAL_COUNT_MISMATCH), a serial given twice or already in stock (SERIAL_DUPLICATE), a lot-tracked product without a lot (LOT_REQUIRED), a unit with no conversion (UNIT_CONVERSION), and a closed or missing destination (LOCATION_CLOSED, LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE).

service.description: Finish a short purchase receipt (ReceiveRemaining): only what was received stays on it, and the remainder of each line is either closed, through Purchasing's close of purchase remainders (mantle.order.OrderServices.close#PurchaseRemainders' close, run in this operation under its STOCK_RECEIVE check: cancel#OrderItem with the explicit remainder, the Requirement allocation and the budget commitment released, the order completed when nothing is open), or backordered, this receipt's items lowered to what was received (update#ShipmentItem) and the order part's remainder put on its open receipt (ensure#PurchaseReceipt). Only then is the receipt delivered (deliver#Shipment, whose ShipmentIncomingDeliveredCreateInvoices SECA bills the accepted quantity of a self-billing supplier as Accounting conditioned it), unless the close cancelled a receipt that received nothing. A remainder sends the receipt exception notice. A retry with the same operation key answers the first. Requires STOCK_RECEIVE; refuses a receipt outside the user's facilities (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), not a purchase receipt (RECEIPT_TYPE) or no longer open (RECEIPT_CLOSED), a choice other than close or backorder (CHOICE_INVALID) and a missing reason (REASON_REQUIRED).

parameter.name: choice
parameter.description: close or backorder.

parameter.name: reason
parameter.description: Required: checked by the service (REASON_REQUIRED).

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode CLOSED or BACKORDERED, shipmentId, choice, reason, lines (productId, expected, received, remaining), orders (close: orderId, closedItems, orderStatusId, releasedCommitments), backorders (backorder: orderId, orderPartSeqId, shipmentId), delivered, shipmentStatusId.

return.message: CHOICE_INVALID: Choose to close the remainder or to backorder it
REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason the receipt is short

set.from: lines.map(row => ({productId: row.productId, expected: receiving.text(row.expected), received: receiving.text(row.received), remaining: receiving.text(row.remaining)}))

if.script: receiving.notifyException(recv, choice == 'close' ? 'CLOSED' : 'BACKORDERED', {reason: reason.trim(), lines: lineRows.filter(row => row.remaining != '0')})

set.from: posting.complete(begun.op, recv.facility.ownerPartyId, 'mantle.shipment.Shipment', shipmentId, {resultCode: choice == 'close' ? 'CLOSED' : 'BACKORDERED', shipmentId: shipmentId, choice: choice, reason: reason.trim(), lines: lineRows, orders: orders, backorders: backorders, delivered: delivered, shipmentStatusId: final.statusId})

service.description: GenerateTracking's preview: serial or lot values for many units, from a first value counted up (its trailing number, width kept) or the tracking policy's serial or lot pattern ({seq} or {seq:N}, {yyyy}, {yy}, {MM}, {dd} in the user's zone, {product}), each flagged when it is a duplicate: a serial already on the product's stock (IN_STOCK), a lot number already used (LOT_EXISTS, of the manufacturer when given), or given twice (REPEATED).
